title: Standard invoice within value ceiling
description: Modelled on the worked computation in VAOM v5 Section 8, with two departures. Model certainty carries no weight here: an agent's stated certainty can only lower a score (it keeps the paper's 0.70 floor). Independent verification isn't a dimension: the row's verificationRequired keeps Band A behind a passing verifier instead. Rule match reads only the action's own facts; a PO three-way match against the ERP is the verifier's job. Weights, floors and penalties are illustrative, as the paper's are.
